item_short_desc: Show your support for NASA with the official NASA Meatball Logo Patch.
description: Show your support for NASA with the official NASA Meatball Logo Patch. The blue sphere represents a planet, the stars are to represent space itself, the red v-shaped vector is a wing representing aeronautics, and then there is an orbiting spacecraft going around the wing. Rothco's morale patches feature a hook backing and are ideal for attaching to our Operator Caps, Combat Shirts or any of our Hook & Loop gear.
